reason: The final process-entry closing/capture boundary consumes any Throwable only into the specified fixed bootstrap status50 and literal diagnostic. Termination is invoked with that observed status, not success. This is the approved standalone ADMIN entry contract, not ordinary JMS worker fatal ranking; this review issues no ADMIN operation.

The entry operation failure retains default status50 and only fixed public diagnostics. Input nulls are rejected before actions; the subsequent finished label is an entry diagnostic rather than proof of successful schema/admin/bootstrap. No role/key/DB operation is performed by this applicability review.

A failed PT capture changes the process result to50 and cannot create native qualification. The capture-complete diagnostic is printed only after a true capture result. An attempted/error capture remains distinct from confirmed stream evidence.

current aliases the last already-owned directory in held. It is not a new acquisition. Recursive children enter ResourceScope immediately and remain in the held chain during child access; closing this borrowed alias locally would violate the parent lifetime. This review reads source only, not actual root/CA files.

An actual typed purge failure leaves purgeSucceeded=false and after=null; no fabricated after count or unattempted failure is emitted. A separate observed health result determines WARNING versus FAILED. The empty catch deliberately preserves that result contract, not a successful purge.

Typed management-health failure leaves healthy=false, forcing FAILED and preventing startup admission even if purge completed. It does not silently turn unavailable Ops into healthy or reuse a previous observation.

Private stateLock serializes the full quiescence observation against object state, not caller-monitor ownership. Exact parent/budget/manager/kernel checks are still required before Optional presence; synchronization itself proves no real Unit termination or lock release.

A descriptor disappearing during read adds no owned socket evidence. Remaining listeners must still satisfy the exact captured owner checks; the absent entry is not a clean stop or a fabricated matching socket.

A concurrently closed FD is skipped without adding an ownership witness. Missing evidence cannot satisfy the exact listener/socket requirement or prove process termination; this is not a retry or access to a live process by the review.
